verdict.rationale: Rootly documents operating incidents through natural-language commands to @Rootly in Slack, for example "This is now a SEV1. Update the incident severity," "Page the security team, and convert this to a private incident," and "page the database on-call team." It also offers a natural-language AI chat on web and mobile, and an MCP server that lets agents query incidents and take action. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the NL commands, a documented list of which actions NL commands can perform, and write actions from the web chat (documented as read-only).
